description.zh: 解决“今天吃什么”：按人数、口味和忌口排出荤素搭配、一周不重样的菜单，自动合并成分好类的买菜清单；讲清家常菜的用量、火候和替代食材，帮你用冰箱里现有的食材做饭，兼顾孩子、老人和减脂需求，提醒食品安全。
description.en: Answers "what's for dinner": balanced weekly menus without repeats for your household, tastes and allergies, merged and categorized shopping lists, clear quantities and techniques for home dishes, substitutions, fridge clean-out ideas and food-safety tips.

welcome_message.zh: 告诉我家里几口人、爱吃什么、有什么忌口
welcome_message.en: Tell me how many people, what you like and any allergies

prompt.zh: 家里 ___ 口人，帮我排一周午饭和晚饭，不吃 ___。
prompt.en: ___ people at home. Plan lunch and dinner for a week; we don't eat ___.

prompt.zh: 按这个菜单生成 ___ 人份的买菜清单：___
prompt.en: Make a shopping list for ___ people from this menu: ___

prompt.zh: ___ 怎么做？___ 人份，写清楚用量和火候。
prompt.en: How do I make ___ for ___ people? Include amounts and heat.
I have ___ in the fridge. What can I cook?

prompt.zh: 下班只有 20 分钟，推荐几个 ___ 人份的快手菜。
prompt.en: I only have 20 minutes after work. Suggest quick dishes for ___.

prompt.zh: 我做的 ___ 出现了 ___（太咸/肉老/出水），是哪里出了问题？
prompt.en: My ___ turned out ___ (salty/tough/watery). What went wrong?

zh: 每周日「18:00」生成下周菜单和买菜清单
每周三「20:00」提醒第二次采购生鲜
每天「16:30」发送今晚的菜品和准备步骤（解冻、腌制）
每天「21:00」提醒剩菜放凉后冷藏
每月 1 日「10:00」检查冰箱冷冻室食材，列出快到期的
每月最后一个周末「10:00」推荐 2 道新菜加入菜单
en: Every Sunday at 18:00, plan next week's menu and shopping list
Every Wednesday at 20:00, remind to restock fresh produce
Every day at 16:30, send tonight's dishes and prep steps (thawing, marinating)
Every day at 21:00, remind to refrigerate leftovers once cooled
On the 1st of each month at 10:00, check the freezer and list items to use soon
On the last weekend of each month at 10:00, suggest 2 new dishes to try
